newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - May 28.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - May 28.

text.p: -- CUC International Inc and HFS Inc said they reached a definitive agreement to merge in a deal that would create a consumer and business services company with a market capitalization of $22 billion. The companies said CUC would issue about 434 million shares, valued at about $11 billion, in exchange for all outstanding HFS shares.

-- Staples Inc and Office Depot Inc said that because of pending litigation with the Federal Trade Commission, they had approved two amendments to their merger agreement. Terms of the merger pact would be extended until June 30 and termination rights were amended, they said.
-- Donna Karan International Inc is expected to put forth a cost-cutting plan designed to get the fashion house back on track, the New York Times reported.
-- State attorneys general involved in talks with tobacco companies have started discussing the possibility of turning to insurers in any settlement, the Wall Street Journal reported.
